title: Tray.io Pricing 2026: What Mid-Sized Companies Pay
summary: Tray.io pricing models require a clear understanding of your team's integration volume to select the most cost-effective subscription tier.
body_markdown:
## Why Tray.io justifies its premium enterprise price tag


The ability to offload complex logic from specialized engineering teams to business users through its "Universal Automation" hub is how Tray.io justifies its premium pricing. By centralizing a complex logic tree, the platform reduces the need for custom middleware development.


Licensing accounts for 40% of the total cost in the traditional "Enterprise automation budget split," which these high fees displace, leaving little room for actual innovation or operational agility. McKinsey data shows this leaves the majority of expenditure for operational and technical overhead.


### Tray.io Merlin AI agent builder pricing value


Teams can deploy autonomous agents that handle high-reasoning tasks without writing Python or Javascript using the Merlin AI builder. When utilizing Gemini 3.8 Flash for rapid classification or Claude Opus 5.5 for long-running knowledge work, the platform abstracts the API orchestration.


30% of the total cost is represented by implementation, meaning nearly one-third of the budget is spent just getting the system live.


Infrastructure accounts for 20%, which is the cost of the underlying servers and compute required to host the logic, necessitating a constant overhead regardless of how efficiently the workflows are designed.


Maintenance takes up the final 10%, representing the ongoing labor to fix broken paths or update API versions, so teams are perpetually tethered to reactive troubleshooting rather than new development. The system degrades without consistent human intervention.


### Tray.io custom connector SDK pricing


Non-developers can build production-ready integrations for internal tools that lack public APIs using the Tray.io Connector SDK. This "Universal" approach allows legacy systems to be integrated into modern AI-driven stacks using models like GPT-6 Astra for complex decision-making.


By allowing a marketing manager to build a connector for a proprietary SQL database, the company avoids the 30% implementation cost typically paid to external consultants, drastically reducing the barrier to entry for non-technical staff and accelerating time-to-value.


### Enterprise-grade security and compliance standards


By providing a centralized governance layer that monitors every data movement across the logic tree, the platform justifies its cost. This is essential for highly regulated industries where using Gemini 3.1 Pro for medical coding or GPT-5.6 Cyber for vulnerability research requires strict audit trails.


Tray.io’s managed compliance environment ensures that scaling automations doesn't create new legal liabilities.
